errors.text_span: Четвъртият сектор е синьо-тъмносиньо, с етикет „Няколко пъти месечно“ и заема 9,1%.
errors.evidence: The description states that the dark blue sector ("Няколко пъти месечно") accounts for 9.1%. However, this slice has no percentage label in the chart. Based on the total of 22 responses, it should be approximately 4.5% (1 response). It is also visibly smaller than the slices labeled 9.1%.

errors.text_span: Петият сектор е червен, с етикет „Всеки месец“ и заема 9,1%.
errors.evidence: The description states that the red sector ("Всеки месец") accounts for 9.1%. However, this slice has no percentage label in the chart. Based on the total of 22 responses, it should be approximately 4.5% (1 response). It is also visibly smaller than the slices labeled 9.1%.
The color of the sixth sector ("Не сме организирали обучения по лидерство") is described as "dark blue-blue", but it is clearly cyan or light blue in the chart.

errors.text_span: Всички сектори са етикетирани с проценти вътре в тях
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that all sectors are labeled with percentages. In fact, only four out of the six sectors have percentage labels; the dark blue and red sectors do not.

errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени по низходящ размер, като най-големите сектори са зеления и оранжевия, следвани от останалите с равни размери.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect on two counts. First, the sectors are not arranged in descending order of size. Second, the four smaller sectors are not of equal size; there are two slices at 9.1% and two smaller slices at approximately 4.5% each.
